title: Fasalolin dandali
requiredTextNote: Wasu alamun rubutu ana buƙatarsu kuma koyaushe suna kunne (an nuna su a kashe).
featuresWarning: Kashe waɗannan zaɓuɓɓuka na iya cire manyan damar rubutu da gudanarwa.
largeSiteWarning: Wannan shafin yanar gizo yana da shafuka da yawa. Ƙirƙirar kwarangwal na iya ɗaukar lokaci.
skeletonLargeSiteConfirm: Wannan gidan yanar gizo yana da shafuka {count}. Samar da kwarangwal na iya ɗaukar lokaci kuma ya ƙirƙiri babban fayil. A ci gaba?
toolbarPreviewAlt: Samfotin sandar kayan aikin gyara na {audience}
addPageFeatureDescription: Yana ba da damar ƙirƙirar sabbin shafuka daga sandar sama, ayyukan tsari, da ayyukan binciken umarni.
deletePageFeatureDescription: Yana ba da damar share shafuka daga ayyukan shafi, ayyukan tsari, da hanyoyin gudanarwa masu alaƙa.
outlineDesignerFeatureDescription: Yana kunna kayan aikin tsarin gidan yanar gizo, gami da ayyukan tsari da ayyukan gudanarwar Tsari.
styleGuideFeatureDescription: Yana nuna damar shiga Jagorar Salo a kayan aikin gudanarwa da gajerun hanyoyin binciken umarni.
insightsFeatureDescription: Yana kunna Rahotanni a gudanarwa da binciken umarni don kallon nazari da fahimta su kasance.
siteManifestFeatureDescription: Yana sarrafa sassan Saitunan Gidan Yanar Gizo don Cikakkun bayanai, Tubala, da tsarin Edita.
themeManifestFeatureDescription: Yana kunna sashen saitunan Kamanni/Jigo a gudanarwar gidan yanar gizo.
authorManifestFeatureDescription: Yana kunna bayanin martabar marubuci da saitunan bayanan marubuci a gudanarwar gidan yanar gizo.
seoManifestFeatureDescription: Yana kunna saitunan inganta injin bincike da bayanan meta a gudanarwar gidan yanar gizo.
pageBreakFeatureDescription: Yana nuna sarrafawar gyaran bayanan meta na matakin shafi kamar take, gunki, matsayi, alamomi, da kullewa.
addBlockFeatureDescription: Yana nuna mai binciken tubala kuma yana ba da damar ƙara sabbin tubalan abun ciki yayin gyara.
popularGizmosFeatureDescription: Yana nuna sashen tubala masu farin jini a cikin mai zaɓar tubala.
recentGizmosFeatureDescription: Yana nuna sashen tubala na kwanan nan a cikin mai zaɓar tubala.
contentMapFeatureDescription: Yana nuna allon taswira/tsarin abun cikin shafi yayin gyaran abun ciki.
viewSourceFeatureDescription: Yana kunna kallon tushen HTML don gyara lambar shafi kai tsaye.
uploadMediaFeatureDescription: Yana kunna hanyoyin ɗora fayil da damar sarrafa kafofin watsa labarai/fayiloli masu alaƙa.
onlineMediaFeatureLabel: Binciken kafofin watsa labarai na kan layi
onlineMediaFeatureDescription: Yana kunna haɗin kafofin watsa labarai na kan layi da tushen binciken kafofin watsa labarai na nesa.
communityFeatureDescription: Yana kunna mahallin binciken umarni mai alaƙa da al'umma da ayyukan isar da saƙo.
